post.caption: In Titanic, the Heart of the Ocean necklace was only a prop, and its blue stone was cubic zirconia because a real one cost too much. After the hit film, Asprey of London made a real version with a heart shaped Sri Lankan sapphire of about 170 carats, set with diamonds. It was auctioned for charity in Beverly Hills in March 1998 and sold for 2.2 million dollars. The buyer stayed unnamed but let Celine Dion wear it to the Oscars on March 23, 1998, where Titanic won eleven awards.
